'''2005 U.S. National Championship Joe Giannetti DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2005 U.S. National Championship]], finishing Top 4; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2005-07-26).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35022 Josephn Giannetti's Jenkinsssss! - Origins 2005 Top 4]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225554/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35022 Internet Archive]</ref>
